summary: A macos job in .github/workflows/nightly.yml, on macos-latest, that downloads and SHA-512-verifies the pinned macOS Godot app zip and the same pinned export templates, builds the Rust GDExtension with tools/build-native-bridge.sh release, and asserts the dylib is where Godot resolves it before exporting E4's macOS preset and uploading project42-macos-<sha> with an unsigned/unnotarised README. The job builds the dylib and then refuses: the export cannot complete because of two things in game/ that this workflow does not own, both named below with their exact log lines. No macOS artifact is uploaded yet, and nothing pretends one is.

coordination.notes: E5 owns nightly.yml and is completed; this lane adds one job to it and rewrites the "macOS is deliberately absent" comment E5 left in the desktop matrix, which is that comment's own stated exit condition. No second workflow and no second engine-download path: the macOS job is E5's step sequence with the macOS asset, the macOS binary path inside Godot.app, shasum in place of sha512sum and the macOS export_templates directory. Blocked on E4: game/bin/project42_sim.gdextension must declare a macos.release row for the architecture Godot asks for (macos-latest is arm64), and game/export_presets.cfg's macOS preset must set binary_format/architecture="universal" because the official template archive ships only godot_macos_release.universal. Both are one-line changes in E4's files and neither is made here. Nothing under godot-rust/, game/, content/, tools/ or docs/SHIP_PLAN.md is touched by this lane.

checks: YAML parses: python3 -c 'import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open(".github/workflows/nightly.yml"))' on the committed tree, jobs desktop, macos, packs, triggers schedule + workflow_dispatch only: passed

The macOS engine is pinned, never --no-verify. GODOT_MACOS_SHA512 is 38aa16e5...bac69ca, the line for Godot_v4.7.2-stable_macos.universal.zip in the published SHA512-SUMS.txt of the 4.7.2-stable godotengine/godot-builds release -- the same file whose linux.x86_64 and export_templates lines match E5's two existing pins character for character, which is what identifies it as the right source. Fetched once and the digest recomputed independently (sha512sum of the 170,622,178-byte download) before it was written into the workflow. Verified with shasum -a 512 --check --strict before the archive is unpacked, in Nightly run 34025105405 and every run since: passed

The macOS engine runs headless on the runner and reports the pinned version, Nightly run 34025105405 job "Export macOS": "Godot Engine v4.7.2.stable.official.ed1daf0bf", from Godot.app/Contents/MacOS/Godot inside the pinned archive: passed

The export templates are the same .tpz E5 pins, unpacked into ~/Library/Application Support/Godot/export_templates/4.7.2.stable, which is where macOS looks rather than ~/.local/share/godot. No second digest was added because one archive carries every platform's templates: passed

tools/build-native-bridge.sh release builds the macOS dylib on the runner unchanged -- it already handles Darwin via uname -s, giving platform macos, libproject42_sim.dylib and game/bin/macos/. Nightly run 34026109145 job "Export macOS", step "Build the native bridge", ~3.5 minutes cold, then the assertion printed "game/bin/macos/project42_sim.macos.expedition_v5_release.x86_64.dylib: Mach-O 64-bit dynamically linked shared library arm64": passed

One runner builds one architecture, and the workflow says so rather than assuming. macos-latest is Apple Silicon ("Runner architecture: arm64" in run 34025682879), so the dylib is arm64 whatever the x86_64 in its file name says; a universal binary would need two host builds merged and nothing in this workflow can do that. The fact is printed in the job and repeated in the artifact README step: passed

The export does NOT complete, and this is the finding rather than a green. Nightly run 34025105405 job "Export macOS" (the first version, whose assertion still only checked that the .gdextension mentions macos.release.x86_64) reached the export and Godot answered, verbatim: "ERROR: No GDExtension library found for current OS and architecture (macos.arm64) in configuration file: res://bin/project42_sim.gdextension", then "ERROR: Export: Requested template binary \"godot_macos_release.x86_64\" not found. It might be missing from your template archive.", then "ERROR: Project export for preset \"macOS\" failed." and exit code 1. No artifact was uploaded and none was claimed: failed

Blocker 1, not fixable in this file: game/bin/project42_sim.gdextension declares only macos.debug.x86_64 and macos.release.x86_64, and Godot on an Apple Silicon runner resolves macos.arm64. E4 owns that file. The assertion in this job was tightened to refuse on it by name instead of letting Godot export a build with no simulation in it -- Nightly run 34026109145: "game/bin/project42_sim.gdextension declares no macos.release.arm64 row." / "Godot on this runner asks for macos.arm64 and reports \"No GDExtension library found for current OS and architecture (macos.arm64)\", so the exported build would carry no simulation. Refusing." / "The dylib built above is at game/bin/macos/project42_sim.macos.expedition_v5_release.x86_64.dylib. It is game/bin/project42_sim.gdextension -- E4's file, not this workflow -- that has to declare it for this architecture.", followed by the two macos lines of that file: failed

Blocker 2, not fixable in this file: game/export_presets.cfg's macOS preset sets binary_format/architecture="x86_64", and there is no per-architecture macOS export template to satisfy it. Confirmed against the pinned archive itself, not from memory: Godot_v4.7.2-stable_export_templates.tpz contains exactly one macOS entry, templates/macos.zip, and inside it macos_template.app/Contents/MacOS/godot_macos_release.universal (170,132,160 bytes) and godot_macos_debug.universal (186,205,680 bytes) -- no godot_macos_release.x86_64. The preset needs "universal". E4 owns that file: failed

Bite proof: the macOS native bridge build was replaced by a no-op and pushed (798b371). Nightly run 34025963084's "Export macOS" failed at the step named "Confirm the GDExtension library is installed where Godot looks" with "The macOS export needs game/bin/macos/project42_sim.macos.expedition_v5_release.x86_64.dylib and it is not there." / "Exporting now would package a build with no simulation in it. Refusing.", and Import, Export, the archive check, the README and Upload were all skipped. Restored in fd5a5f9: passed

A first bite attempt (6cc042d) failed at the wrong step and was treated as a defect, not a tick: a separate "Report what architecture this runner built" step ran before the assertion and died as "fatal error: ... lipo: can't open input file: game/bin/macos/project42_sim.macos.expedition_v5_release.x86_64.dylib (No such file or directory)". A step that reports facts must not run before the step that checks them, so the report was folded into the assertion after the existence check and the bite re-run: passed

workflow_dispatch could not be used, exactly as E5 found: GitHub registers a workflow_dispatch workflow only from the default branch. Proven instead with a temporary branch-scoped push trigger, added in eb9b27b and removed in 3f19192; runs 34025105405, 34025682879, 34025963084 and 34026109145 are runs of this file with nothing but that trigger and the bite differing. The final committed file therefore has no run of its own, which is the same limitation E5 recorded: passed

E5's Linux and Windows legs and E9's packs still pass beside the new job on every one of those runs -- e.g. run 34026109145: "Export Linux Desktop" success, "Export Windows Desktop" success, "Build the presentation packs" success. The macOS job is the only red one: passed
node tools/src/check-claims.mjs on the committed tree: passed

Not run in this lane because nothing under godot-rust/, content/, game/ or tools/ was touched -- this lane's whole diff is .github/workflows/nightly.yml: cargo fmt, cargo test, cargo check --features godot-ext, node tools/src/validate.mjs and the content bundle rebuild: not_run
